e133_hackage_experiment.key_finding: Need-related Haskell packages have 2.90x higher mean download activity than random packages (19,821 vs 6,844 mean downloads). All gates G1-G4 pass with 100% classification coverage using tag-based classification.
e133_hackage_experiment.build_decision: E133 prototype built and tested; tag-based classification of Hackage packages achievable; sample-size-dependent effect observed; no candidate generated
